items.title: What Are Claude Code Mods?
items.summary: Claude Code mods are small functions that run inside Claude Code and can let an action through, change it, or stop it before it happens. Skills, hooks and MCP servers can't do that, because they sit outside Claude Code. The full video shows how to install mods and the custom Claude Code I built with them: https://youtu.be/XaYubuLtW8M #ClaudeCode #ClaudeMods #Anthropic #AIAgents #codingagents

items.title: Stanford Univ: New AI Attention: SwiLA
items.summary: Softmax attention’s KV-cache is a dead end for infinite (or extreme large) context, but standard Linear Attention fundamentally destroys associative recall (Mamba, DeltaNet). So how do we get the best of both worlds? Meet SwiLA (Switching Linear Attention) by Stanford Univ. Switching Linear Attention completely eliminates the transformer's massive memory cache without sacrificing associative recall by modeling sequence routing as online expectation-maximization over a mixture of linear regressors. Dive into the math of how this non-linear recurrence dynamically routes context to constant-size memory experts, finally fixing the critical flaw of sub-quadratic language models. All rights w/ authors: Switching Linear Attention Hyun Dong Lee∗ Stanford University Xavier Gonzalez Stanford University† Nicolas Zucchet Stanford University E. Kelly Buchanan Stanford University Emily B. Fox Stanford University Scott W. Linderman Stanford University arXiv:2609.39034 #airesearch #aitechnology #aiexplained #newstoday

items.title: Claude Mods - The Biggest Claude Code Upgrade!
items.summary: Claude Code mods let you run your own JavaScript or TypeScript functions inside Claude Code. A mod can watch, change or stop a tool call before it runs, and it can draw its own panels in the terminal and the desktop app. In this video I explain what a Claude Code mod is and how it differs from hooks, skills and MCP servers. Then I show how to install mods from a marketplace and how I had Claude write a set of mods for my own workflow. The session-audit prompt I use (by Vox): https://x.com/Voxyz_ai/status/2105778540251644176 Claude Code mods docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods Getting started with Claude Code mods: https://claude.dev/blog/getting-started-with-claude-code-mods Mods walkthrough by Lydia Hallie (Claude Code team): https://x.com/lydiahallie/status/2106127556491821499 Claude Code changelog: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md DeepSeek Harness: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness Mods run on your machine with your permissions. Read a mod, or run claude plugin validate on it, before you install it. items.title: Future of Science and Technology Q&A (October 2, 2026)
items.summary: Stephen Wolfram hosts an unscripted Ask Me Anything about the future of science and technology for all ages. Originally livestreamed at: https://twitch.tv/stephen_wolfram If you missed the original livestream of this episode, feel free to submit a question you would like Stephen to answer in a future Q&A livestream here: https://wolfr.am/12cczmv5J 00:00 Start stream 00:21 We would benefit from your take on the recent advances in scientific, particularly mathematics, advancements of LLMs, including the Navier-Stokes proof of singularity. How does this affect the future of science and the future of scientists? Would be wonderful if you would discuss the recent Navier Stokes Open AI advance and claimed 'misalignment' by academic mathematicians who claim AI companies stall Mathematics? Cedric Villani said problems are drying up. Tao thinks it's bad for math community etc. 20:58 What do you think is going to happen in the future of academic publishing 1:00:54 What parts of the traditional journal model are still worth preserving? 1:04:45 When you get a number turning out to be infinite which ought to be finite, shouldn't you admit that there is something wrong with your equations, rather than hope you can get a good theory just by doctoring up that number? 1:06:01 Can you reverse engineer the code to detect whether an image is AI generated? Particularly relevant in the UK sovereign AI defense sector now. 1:07:59 End stream Follow us on our official social media channels. items.title: How Salesforce Untangled Its Own Data Chaos
items.summary: In episode 1032 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Michael Andrew, CDO at Salesforce how Salesforce tackled its internal data chaos, including duplicate records and disparate systems, leading to the development and deployment of their Data 360 product. Michael explains how they unified customer data from various sources like Snowflake, Amazon data lake, and multiple Salesforce instances to create a single, actionable customer view. This integration now allows their sales team to receive proactive alerts, such as when a customer is about to run out of credits, demonstrating the power of a connected data strategy.
